asked_by: Madhav, 27 Oct 2026 09:17 Toronto: "Yes to all your recommendations" (the recommendation, after reviewing his 25-question Ask session of 27 Oct: test the topics Ananta could only answer from the textbook: candlestick patterns, valuation (P/E, P/B), beta and low volatility, option spreads, corporate actions)
title: Nifty valuation: does an expensive Nifty (high P/E or P/B, low dividend yield) come before weaker returns, and a cheap one before better returns?
hypothesis: When the Nifty 50's P/E or P/B is in the top tenth of its own history (or its dividend yield in the bottom tenth), the next 60 and 250 sessions are weaker than other times; when it is cheap (bottom-tenth P/E, top-tenth yield) they are better.

data.valuation: silver/valuation/index_pepb.parquet (NSE daily P/E, P/B, dividend yield of the NIFTY 50, 1999-2023)
data.method_break: NSE moved P/E and P/B from standalone to consolidated earnings on 31 Mar 2021 (pe_basis column). P/E and P/B are used ONLY on the standalone basis (to 30 Mar 2021); the dividend yield has no basis change and is used to 2023
data.nothing_sealed: no 2024+ row; nothing was looked at for outcomes before this spec

definitions.percentile: expanding: the share of all earlier days (from 1999, same basis) with a lower value; needs 750 earlier days; known at the day's close
definitions.outcome: Nifty close 60 (or 250) sessions after the NEXT session's close, divided by the next session's close, minus 1 (no cost: a market-timing reading)

statistics.test: india.teachers_stock.msplit: block means of 'on' sessions against block means of the other sessions with a percentile and an outcome; quarter blocks for 60 sessions, year blocks for 250
statistics.honest_limit: 250-session rows use year blocks: 2003-2017 holds at most 15 and 2018-2023 at most 6, under the 16-block rule, so they CANNOT reach a verdict (INCONCLUSIVE by design; recorded for the numbers). P/E and P/B rows in validation stop at Mar 2021 (about 13 quarters), also under 16
statistics.periods: development to 2017, validation 2018-2023; nothing from 2024 on, no sealed folder
statistics.verdict: india/registry.record standard rule; 16 blocks per period

bar.note: a new family 'valuation'; k frozen at the 6 variants below

not_claimed: No paper rule changes; a market-timing pass would be a proposal for the allocation rule review, not a change.
